neighbours.label: ' by' after 'characterized' or 'marked' in the definition of a disease (what the condition's symptoms are), as opposed to other 'by' phrases about the same disease
fire: Lupus is an autoimmune disease characterized by joint pain and rashes.
Anorexia is an eating disorder marked by extreme food restriction.
Emphysema is a lung condition characterized by damaged air sacs.
Bipolar disorder is an illness marked by swings in mood.
Parkinson's is a progressive disease characterized by tremor.
Schizophrenia is a chronic disorder characterized by delusions.
Gout is a form of arthritis marked by sudden attacks of pain.
Rickets is a childhood condition characterized by soft bones.
quiet: Lupus is an autoimmune disease treated by rheumatologists.
Anorexia is an eating disorder studied by many psychologists.
Emphysema is a lung condition caused by smoking.
Bipolar disorder is an illness managed by psychiatrists.
Parkinson's is a progressive disease named by a later neurologist.
Schizophrenia is a chronic disorder diagnosed by specialists.
Gout is a form of arthritis treated by rest and cold packs.
Rickets is a childhood condition prevented by vitamin D.
